blockers.problem: The bootstrap removes implicit cross-job code and data that existing jobs assume is present. family-rule-tail/job.py:7 executes source-ladder/job.py, but its declared closure does not contain fetch_ladder.py, ladder_queue.py, ofr_index.py or plan.py, so it cannot run. source-ladder/job.py:157-160 also silently loses OFR routes because jobs/fr-originals/data/ofr_index is omitted.
blockers.smallest_safe_correction: Retain historical jobs availability for unproven selections. Narrow only an explicitly audited allowlist (example-hello and early-ranger-transcriptions); materialize all jobs for any other selection until existing job dependencies are declared. Code/data-only bootstrap alone does not fix R2.

blockers.problem: Existing dynamic output discovery is broader than declarations. Claim-checker iterates every jobs/*/output/SOURCES.jsonl, while its closure omits committed fr-pages/output/SOURCES.jsonl and app-executive-orders/output/SOURCES.jsonl. checker.py:522 also reads omitted app-executive-orders/output/MIRROR_DOCUMENTS.jsonl. claim-drafts/drafts.py:398-420 dynamically merges every available output folder. Sparse omission can silently reduce evidence.
blockers.smallest_safe_correction: Use broad jobs fallback for these jobs and unproven selections, or complete and test dynamic custody closure before enabling narrow checkout.
